name: InitializeResponse
reason: Name matches upstream (protocol/v1.rs InitializeResponse); the v2 aggregate simply does not carry it, although it does carry InitializeParams. Not a naming divergence.

name: FuzzyFileSearchResponse
reason: Declared upstream in protocol/common.rs:1882 rather than under protocol/v2/, so the v2 aggregate omits it while still carrying FuzzyFileSearchParams/Result/MatchType. Hand-written in internal/protocol/schema/handwritten.go from the source shape.

name: CommandExecutionApprovalDecision
reason: Correct upstream name (protocol/v2/item.rs:66); absent from the v2 aggregate even though the params it belongs to are present. Renamed from the SDK's former 'ApprovalDecision', which was a local invention with the same wire values.

name: FileChangeApprovalDecision
reason: Correct upstream name (protocol/v2/item.rs:115); absent from the v2 aggregate for the same reason as CommandExecutionApprovalDecision.

name: PermissionGrantScope
reason: Correct upstream name (protocol/v2/permissions.rs:789, generated from CorePermissionGrantScope); absent from the v2 aggregate. Renamed from the SDK's former 'PermissionsScope'.

name: ItemKind
reason: Names the item discriminator upstream expresses structurally: ThreadItem is a tagged enum whose variants carry a camelCase `type` value, and there is no named enum for it in the schema. The SDK needs a name to switch on, so it keeps one; the string values are exactly the upstream tags.
